content:
The conservative news aggregation site — which has been no stranger to trashing the president in recent years — led with “Trump Thanksgiving Tantrum,” linking to a story about the president’s fury-filled social media posts over the holiday.

It illustrated its splash with an image of a gigantic Trump-inspired balloon.

Trump spent part of the early hours of Thanksgiving morning lashing out at veteran New York Times journalist David E. Sanger.

Later in the day, he fired off a lengthy, sarcastic Thanksgiving message calling out his supposed enemies.

The image featured on the Drudge Report homepage appeared to show the 20-foot-tall, so-called Trump Baby Blimp, which made its debut flight in London in 2018 during protests against the president’s visit to the United Kingdom.

The balloon is now housed at the London Museum, where it forms part of the venue’s protest collection.
